criteria.name: truth and qualifier fidelity
criteria.full_credit: Every factual clause maps exactly to a PT-* truth and preserves synthetic/held-out/manual qualifiers.

criteria.name: audience relevance
criteria.full_credit: The agency owner or operator immediately recognizes the post-call follow-up situation without invented pains.

criteria.name: singular promise
criteria.full_credit: Each option has one concrete promise and avoids generic AI, optimization, and pipeline abstractions.

criteria.name: evidence specificity
criteria.full_credit: The option uses relevant frozen proof with the exact denominator or context needed to interpret it.

criteria.name: coherent opening progression
criteria.full_credit: The opening moves from an audience-relevant entry into one consequential promise and claim-matched support without forcing any route-specific formula.

criteria.name: claim-to-demonstration fit
criteria.full_credit: The proof immediately following a claim proves that claim rather than a neighboring benefit.

criteria.name: sentence continuity
criteria.full_credit: Adjacent lines continue one carried concept; no hook barrage or unexplained conceptual jump.

criteria.name: action and format compliance
criteria.full_credit: Exactly three compliant multi-line options and one unblended recommendation use only the Book a demo action.

hard_failures: unsupported revenue, conversion, pipeline, closed-won, customer, or causal outcome
copied control brand, metric, testimonial, or claim
invented authority, endorsement, mechanism, owner, or date
fixture result described as market or customer evidence
missing or false PT-* evidence mapping
route or expert identity exposed to the blind evaluator
scoring_rule: A hard failure sets the replicate to FAIL regardless of numeric score. Otherwise sum criterion points without route-aware adjustments.
